source: TN Police citizen portal 'Contact Us' API (police.tn.gov.in/digigov)
covers: statewide by unit: 'City' = 9 commissionerates (Chennai 469 rows / 245 units, 236 Inspector rows), 'District' and 'Special Units' also; est. ~1,500 PS
how_to_scrape: Base https://www.police.tn.gov.in/digigov. GET /contactUs/getUnit (3=District, 7=City, 26=Special Units); GET /contactUs/getDistrict?officeTypeId=7 (Chennai City = 70002111); GET /contactUs/getContactUsGrid?unitId=7&dsgnId=&psId=&distId=70002111&villageId= -> responseObject.data[] {unitName, designationName, empName, contactNo, email, address}. Also /contactUs/getPoliceStation?prntOrgId=<distId>.
notes: Officer names + mobiles, but noisy: designations are wrong in places (many station staff listed as 'INSPECTOR GENERAL OF POLICE'), several inspectors per station (L&O, crime, traffic not split), placeholders (9999999999). Many contactNo/email values are PERSONAL (gmail, non-CUG numbers); only 94981xxxxx are CUG. Filter to CUG before publishing. Old hosts tnpolice.gov.in / eservices.tnpolice.gov.in have an EXPIRED certificate (24 Sep 2026); their http:// page redirects to www.police.tn.gov.in. Germany: timeout.
